name: Recovery icon
description: Passive icon: a plus sign, two crossed bars, inside the pale steel border the defensive traits share. Port of the hand-drawn i_recovery from Feelers' BootScene. The tile was venom, matching the bars the way most icons here match their own glyph; it is $steel.light now — the border ss.icon.armor and ss.icon.thorns already wear — because Scab is the trait that finishes the Shell into Quicklime, and the two halves of a recipe have to read as the same shelf before the player is told they are. The cross wears the border's colour too, the rule every passive follows: tile and glyph are one colour, and that colour is the shelf's.
